text: Would love a way to colour shifts by role, not just by employee. Otherwise the app is great!
Just wanted to say thank you. Scheduling used to take me a whole Sunday and now it's 20 minutes.
Please add a dark mode to the web app.
love it
The new layout is much harder to use than the old one. Everything takes more clicks now. Please bring back the old version or let us choose.
It would help if invoices could be split across two clients, for jobs we share with a partner company.
Is it a good idea for me to suggest that maybe, just maybe, a scheduling app should let you schedule more than 4 weeks ahead? Just a thought.
Hi, my suggestion: the app can show weather in schedule? For our ice cream shop the weather decide how many people we need.
Your support person Priya was brilliant yesterday. Please pass on my thanks.
You keep adding features nobody asked for while the basics stay clunky. I've been a customer since 2021 and I'm starting to look elsewhere.
Please add Welsh language
Would be great if staff could see their total hours for the month in the app.
Could you add a feature for tracking staff certifications, like food safety, with expiry reminders?
Ah yes, removing the weekly email summary that everyone used. Bold choice. Please bring it back.
The new icons are cute but the font is too small for older staff. Bigger text option please.
Suggestion for the mobile app: let staff add a note when they swap shifts, so managers know why.
Very good application, my team is happy. Only one wish, please make possible to print schedule in A3 big paper.
Feature request: a 'who's on now' view for the front desk.
HOW is there still no way to set a shift that repeats every other week?? Every competitor has this. It's 2026.
great update
Love the app, one idea: let me duplicate an invoice. Also, the invoice I just sent shows last year's date, which seems wrong.
Would you consider a cheaper plan for very small teams of 2 or 3?
Please let us set a custom start of the pay week. Ours runs Thursday to Wednesday.
The team at Quillstack really listen. The shift-swap feature we asked for is exactly what we needed. Thank you.
Can you add a map of where staff clocked in from? Would help with our mobile cleaners.
I'm sure removing the export-to-spreadsheet shortcut made sense in a meeting somewhere. Out here in the real world we miss it.
I wish the app had a simple chat so I can message one person about their shift.
Idea: show a warning when someone is scheduled for more than 6 days in a row.
Honestly the last three updates made the app worse for us. Slower menus, hidden buttons, more pop-ups. Who is testing this?
Please make app in Tagalog also, many of my workers more comfortable. Thank you very much.
Nice job on the new reports page!
